title: BUGFIX — P1 orchestrator ScriptAgent timeout: add deterministic fallback
rationale: Pipeline analysis shows stage 5 (ScriptAgent) times out at 600s when LLM rewrite is enabled and Ollama is slow/unresponsive. bundles=[] causes all downstream stages (5.5-score, 6-validate, 6-editing) to skip. Live pipeline produces 0 videos even when 11 InsightBriefs exist. Fix: add fallback to agent.run(briefs) (deterministic, no Ollama) when bundles.length===0 after LLM runAsync() — mirrors InsightAgent fallback from Sprint 292.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: after stage 5 ScriptAgent, if bundles.length===0 and briefs.length>0, run fallback stage using agent.run(briefs) (deterministic, no Ollama).
